text: Alright folks, welcome back to the weekly wrap-up, and it's tight at the top as always with JeE-DeY holding a razor-thin two-point lead over Mon-Q and Hot Dog right there in striking distance, while Olivier's The Camaraderie made the biggest splash this week, climbing two spots thanks to a solid performance, though I'm not sure if it was skill or just everyone else hitting the snooze button. We've got a five-way tie for fifth place, which is basically a poker game where everyone's holding the same hand, and it looks like Francis Barrière's Green Jackets took the biggest tumble, dropping three spots and proving that even a little rain can wash away progress, so keep an eye on those bottom feeders like Layne Hudson; Guigui is due for a miracle or a total rebuild, and I'm betting on the latter.
